verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes up-front guidance on "when you need to verify your identity for Companies House" and offers a standalone identity-verification service separate from its online filing service. So the identity-proofing wall is at least signposted before a founder starts filing. However, nothing in the pack shows a consolidated, pre-flow statement of every account and credential step required to file, and nothing confirms that founders don't discover requirements mid-flow. The API authorisation material covers the data API, not filing. Missing for 10: an explicit enumeration of the account and sign-in steps required to file, documentation of any filing-specific credentials or codes, a single pre-start checklist tying account, credential and ID-verification steps to each filing type, and hands-on evidence that no requirements surface only mid-flow.
